steps.message:
ci: run the unit tests from one script

The hosted runner and a local check now run the same command, sh ci/run.sh.

tally: add --min-length

Short words such as 'a' and 'on' crowd out the counts. --min-length N drops words shorter than N characters.

wip: pause word-filters with a resume note

The user asked to pause before --exclude was built. RESUME.md holds the handoff for the next session.
